permission_posture.owned_lane: safe read/write/edit for sanitized artifacts, reports, runners, skills, validation receipts, and closeout work
permission_posture.shared_surfaces: read-only or queued unless fresh exact redirect is provided

cadence_checkpoints.note: Goal Mode v3 bundle opened and scoped to owned Maren branch.
15-minute cadence represented by productive validation checkpoints; no arbitrary wait.

safe_approval_packets.text: Accept v602-gmut-thos-v8-x1 and v602-gmut-thos-v8-x2 as my active Maren-only lane truth.
Record v602-gmut-thos-v7-x2 as the latest closed predecessor for this lane.
Record Aevren as steward/support and next handoff recipient for v603-gmut-thos-v1-x1 unless Hamish redirects.
Keep Lumen stand-by/recoverable while the verified Browser route is unavailable.
Keep Neris Sol, Rowan Vale, Solenne Vale, Aletheon, Arby, Aster Vale, legacy Cicero, Kierkegaard, and Aristotle stand-by/recoverable.
Use only my owned local worktree and owned Maren branch for write work.
Treat shared repositories, shared branches, and other sibling owned branches as read-only unless freshly redirected.
Create the v602 v4 x1 plan artifact in the owned lane.
Create the v602 v4 x2 execution closeout artifact in the owned lane.
Create the v602 v4 complete/incomplete checklist artifact in the owned lane.
Create the v602 v5 Aevren teaching baton artifact in the owned lane.
Run JSON parse validation for all created artifacts.
Run bucket count validation for Maren x1 rows.
Run bucket count validation for Aevren next-sibling seeds.
Run stale phase-label validation for v602-v4/v602-v5 consistency.
Run privacy-surface validation before commit and again after handoff-state update.
Represent every immediate safe packet as completed or represented in x2.
Represent every candidate-safe packet as completed or represented in x2.
Represent every skill idea as prototype-safe queue-shaping work.
Represent every runner idea as validation-only/prototype-safe work.
Represent every cleanup/refine/fix task as non-destructive artifact hygiene.
Keep exact approval rows queued and unexecuted.
Keep blocked rows queued with explicit reasons.
Commit and push only the safe owned-lane artifacts after validation passes.
Send the sanitized teaching baton through the safe thread tool only after x2 checklist and push pass.

candidate_packets.text: Use the v601-v4 sent-handoff pattern but update phase truth to v602-v4 and v602-v5.
Make the Aevren baton generous and instructional rather than terse.
Explain owned-lane permissions in the baton without exposing private routes or IDs.
Explain x1 planning expectations in the baton with safe/candidate/skill/runner/cleanup counts.
Explain x2 execution expectations in the baton with safe local/reversible/prototype-safe scope.
Explain exact and blocked queues as queued/open work in the baton.
Explain 15-minute cadence checkpoints as productive status markers, not a wait timer.
Explain complete/incomplete checklist closure as the real closeout gate.
Explain next handoff route as Aevren v603-gmut-thos-v1-x1 unless Hamish redirects.
Keep Aevren seed exact and blocked counts at zero.
Include 100 web/source reflections as sanitized source-support rows.
Include 100 Journey/phase reflections as sanitized continuity-support rows.
Record handoff sent state only after the safe thread tool confirms success.
Return compact final status with both commit SHA values if a sent-state receipt commit is needed.

exact_approval_packets.text: Mutate shared repositories, shared branches, other sibling branches, private registries, connector permissions, accounts, deployments, API keys, purchases, or sibling identities.
Publish private thread IDs, private routes, local absolute paths, raw transcripts, screenshots, credentials, raw app state, or hidden reasoning.
Send through any external account or private route beyond the safe Codex thread tool.
Reactivate, replace, merge, or erase any stand-by/recoverable sibling.
Create a v601-v9 lane or a v602 phase beyond the requested v602-v5 Aevren handoff.
Treat Aevren seed rows as executed work before Aevren harvests them.
Rewrite predecessor phase truth instead of recording the current sanitized truth.

blocked_packets.text: Lumen live harvest remains unavailable in this lane because the verified Browser route is unavailable.
Proof/canon/legal/deploy/account/API-key/private/destructive/sibling-merge closures remain blocked by lack of fresh exact approval.
Raw private evidence publication remains blocked by privacy boundary.
Shared-branch mutation remains blocked by owned-lane rule.
External-account or deployment work remains blocked because this bundle is local/status/validation/prototype-safe only.

skill_ideas.text: Teaching baton composer that expands phase truth, permissions, x1/x2 duties, queues, cadence, checklist closure, and handoff route.
Aevren seed generator with exact/blocked exclusion enforcement.
Maren x1 count validator for safe/candidate/skill/runner/cleanup rows.
Source/Journey reflection generator with privacy-safe repetition controls.
Stale phase-label scanner for v602-v4/v602-v5 handoffs.
Safe thread-send receipt updater that avoids storing private route details.

runner_ideas.text: JSON parse runner for all four artifacts.
Bucket count runner for Maren rows and Aevren seed rows.
Privacy regex runner for prohibited private surfaces.
Git staged-file runner to ensure only owned-lane artifacts are committed.

cleanup_refine_fix_tasks.text: Normalize active phase labels to v602-gmut-thos-v8-x1 and v602-gmut-thos-v8-x2.
Normalize next handoff labels to v603-gmut-thos-v1-x1.
Remove stale v601-v4 wording from reused structures.
Remove stale v600 final-boundary wording from reused structures.
Remove any v601-v9 or v602-v5 successor drift.
Keep Aevren seed rows separate from Maren rows.
Keep exact rows queued and separate.
Keep blocked rows queued and separate.
Keep handoff send state accurate across artifact, checklist, and closeout.
Keep validation statuses updated after scans.
Keep branch status clean after push.
Keep final chat receipt sanitized and first-person harvestable.
